interpretation: For top-1 routing, normalizing the selected probability by itself plus epsilon makes its within-selection prediction gradient very small. Hard expert choice has no local derivative; balancing losses still supply router gradients. This is a local normalization diagnostic, not a full-model gradient measurement.
scope: Both the baseline and state-conditioned route inherit this behavior. The screen keeps it unchanged. Weak results do not resolve whether market conditioning would help under a different routing design.
